en.t: I do not understand it either.

units.source_text: 不经过僧堂生活是无法明白的呀。

en.t: You cannot understand it without going through life in the monks' hall.

units.source_text: 但话又说回来，我觉得今晚讲义的精髓就在于战败的日子里丝毫不提及战败的事，而只是谈了斩猫的故事。"

en.t: But to return to what I was saying, I think the essence of tonight's lecture lay precisely in saying nothing at all about defeat during the days of defeat, and speaking only of the story of cutting down the cat.
